card.name: Capital O starting a word
card.fires_on: The letter O (or a short piece like cho or o) that begins or sits inside a word whose next piece continues with ver, mission, or similar. Seen most in opioid overdose headings, switchover, and OAB.

modes.label: Opioid/Overdose headings
modes.description: A lone capital O starting Opioid or Overdose in section headings about emergency treatment.

modes.label: Split words beginning over-/o-
modes.description: A word split so that the piece before ver or missions is marked, as in switchover or omissions.

modes.label: Capitalized O-terms
modes.description: A capital O opening a term such as OAB, osteoarthritis or OBTAINING.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with words that start with over-, such as overdose, oversight and overload.
card.plain: It fires on a lone letter O at the start of a word that is about to continue as overdose or a similar over- word.
